How to renew a library card

Library cards are valid for three years. You can renew online, by phone or at any branch. Renewal is free for residents of Elm and costs £12 for non-residents.

Download the app to renew in two taps and get due-date reminders on your phone. Free on iOS and Android.

Bring your current card and one proof of address dated within the last three months. Cards that expired more than a year ago cannot be renewed, and a new card must be issued instead.

Elm Public Library is part of Elm City Council. Opening hours vary by branch.

We use cookies to remember your settings and to measure visits. You can change your choice at any time from the footer.
